subject: AcreetionOS Update — July 23, 2026
body:
Emacs 31.1 has just been released, bringing a plethora of changes and improvements to this versatile editor, and our community is already exploring its potential. This release is a significant milestone, and we're excited to see how it will be utilized within the AcreetionOS ecosystem, which can be explored in more detail on our website at https://acreetionos.org/.

Development
Our continuous integration pipeline has been refined with the implementation of per-pipeline staging directories and relative symlinks for the latest.iso file, making our ISO build process more reliable and efficient. This improvement is a direct result of our community's efforts to refine and stabilize our workflow, ensuring that our users receive the most up-to-date and stable versions of AcreetionOS. For more information on our development process and to stay up-to-date with the latest changes, visit our changelog at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html.

Community
Security updates have been issued recently, including updates for AlmaLinux and the stable kernel set, which includes versions 7.1.10 and 6.18.46. Our community is committed to providing timely and relevant updates, and we encourage all users to stay informed about the latest security patches and updates. For guidance on how to apply these updates and to learn more about our community's efforts, check out our documentation at https://acreetionos.org/docs.html and explore our wiki at https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html. Additionally, users can find the latest news and updates at https://acreetionos.org/flash.html.
